page_title: PAL 0-1 ALM | Las Palmas v Almeria 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Bruno Langa (Almeria) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
90+2' Pejino (Las Palmas) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
90+1' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
88' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but Luis Maximiano comes off his line to gather the ball.
87' The game has come to an end for Julian Araujo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pejino (Las Palmas).

86' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the roof of the net, but is thwarted by a great save from Luis Maximiano.
84' Although Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta (Las Palmas) is just on the bench, Victor Garcia has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
82' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner with a short pass.

82' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the bottom right corner, but Luis Maximiano watches it all the way and makes an easy save. Now Las Palmas have a corner.
80' Substitution. Bruno Langa (Almeria) has come on for Largie Ramazani.
80' The referee shows a yellow card to Marvin (Las Palmas). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
79' A corner kick by Almeria is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
79' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Almeria earn a corner.
78' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

76' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Luis Maximiano was alert and made an astonishing save! The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner.
75' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
74' The corner from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is intercepted by the defence.
74' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marvin (Las Palmas), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Las Palmas force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.

71' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
70' Here is a change. Sergi Cardona is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
70' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
69' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

69' Marvin (Las Palmas) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.

67' Marvin (Las Palmas) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the left side of the goal, but it wasn't dangerous and Luis Maximiano made a comfortable save.
66' It's time for a substitution. Iddrisu Baba (Almeria) comes on in place of Jonathan Viera.
66' Victor Garcia couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) and blew his whistle.
64' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
63' The attendance for today's match is 22805.
61' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) will take the corner.

60' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) latches on to a low pass and without any hesitation whatsoever releases a first-time rocket towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, his long-distance effort is blocked by Luis Maximiano who makes a glorious save! The ball is out of play. Las Palmas win a corner kick.
60' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
60' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) replaces Javier Munoz.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leo Baptistao trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marko Milovanovic (Almeria).
59' Pepe Mel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) replacing Marcos Pena.
58' Marcos Pena (Almeria) makes a slide tackle, but referee Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
55' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
53' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
51' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) dribbles into the box, but Alvaro Valles is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
50' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
49' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
48' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' An attempted cross from Marvin (Las Palmas) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Las Palmas.
46' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) has a goal ruled out for offside!
46' Pepe Mel has made a change at the break. Chumi (Almeria) has come on in place of Aleksandar Radovanovic.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives a chance to Marvin (Las Palmas) and Munir El Haddadi is off.
46' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta makes a switch. Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is coming on in place of Maximo Perrone at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Victor Garcia blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' A pass lands at the feet of Leo Baptistao (Almeria) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

42' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee signals a corner kick to Las Palmas.
41' The Adrian Embarba (Almeria) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Victor Garcia rules it out for a foul.
39' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
36' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post.
34' Almeria take a short corner kick.
31' The free kick from long distance is taken by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
30' It seemed like Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
29' Marc Pubill (Almeria) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
28' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
27' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Robertone (Almeria) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

25' The opposition back off Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Luis Maximiano denies him with the save.
22' The resulting corner from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is cleared.

22' This shall not pass! Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Las Palmas.
20' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
19' Las Palmas take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
14' 0 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Leo Baptistao (Almeria) was set free in the area by Largie Ramazani and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
9' The free kick from long range, taken by Las Palmas, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
8' Alejandro Centelles Plaza (Almeria) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
6' Almeria work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
6' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

5' That's unlucky! Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Almeria will take the kick-off.
Victor Garcia was nominated as the referee for this game.
